rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst, but it introduces uncertain image-specific details and notably understates blastocoel expansion relative to the provided Gardner 3AA label.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, male factor diagnosis, endometrium, prior cycle history, and semen data with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with appropriate caveats about morphology versus ploidy; only minor overreach in linking some speculative factors.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice and support single embryo transfer, luteal support, and limited workup after one failure; minor deviations include some speculative counseling points not strictly guideline-based.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, lifestyle optimization, and future planning, though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
